title: Hearty British Rye Crumble
description: A buttery and crisp festive British dish featuring rye, perfect for a cold winter's day, made in a mason jar.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the rye flour, all purpose flour, and granulated sugar.
Add the cold unsalted butter to the bowl and use a pastry blender to work it into the dry ingredients until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Add the dried fruit and spices to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into the flour mixture and stir until just combined.
Spoon the mixture into a mason jar.
Top the mixture with additional crumbs made from the remaining flour and butter.
Bake the crumble in the preheated oven for 35 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the filling is set.
